name: Sheraton Grand Jakarta Gandaria City Hotel
short_description: A 5-star Sheraton Grand hotel of about 293 rooms built directly atop Gandaria City mall in South Jakarta, offering direct mall access, an outdoor pool and fitness centre, a Club Lounge, and the all-day Anigre buffet restaurant.
ai_summary: Sheraton Grand Jakarta Gandaria City sits atop the Gandaria City superblock in South Jakarta, giving guests direct internal access to a large mall with cinemas, shops and restaurants without stepping outdoors. The roughly 293 rooms are consistently described as spacious (entry Deluxe rooms around 35 sqm), clean and comfortable, with Sheraton Sleep Experience beds, floor-to-ceiling windows and marble bathrooms; upper-floor rooms deliver city views. Independent Indonesian bloggers who stayed here highlighted the productive, restful atmosphere, fast Wi-Fi, and a pool and fitness centre on an upper floor. The all-day Anigre restaurant draws repeat praise for its varied international and Indonesian buffet (sashimi, roasted duck, satay, dimsum), and the Club Lounge is singled out for attentive service and generous spreads. On TripAdvisor the hotel holds about 4.0 of 5 across roughly 1,500 reviews, and OTA aggregate scores run high (around 9.1/10). Service and the mall-integrated location are the standout themes. Watchouts noted by guests include early-morning call-to-prayer noise from a nearby mosque on some room sides, occasional soundproofing gripes, and Jakarta traffic reaching the property.

faqs.question: Is the hotel connected directly to Gandaria City mall?
faqs.answer: Yes. The hotel is built atop the Gandaria City superblock and offers direct indoor access to the mall's shops, restaurants and cinema, so guests can shop and dine without going outside.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK)?
faqs.answer: It is roughly 32 km from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport in South Jakarta; actual drive time varies significantly with Jakarta traffic.

faqs.question: What dining is available at the hotel?
faqs.answer: The all-day Anigre restaurant serves international and Indonesian buffets (sashimi, roasted duck, satay, dimsum and more), and there is a lobby lounge plus a Club Lounge for eligible guests.

reviews.title: Staycation di Sheraton Grand Jakarta Gandaria City Hotel
reviews.source: It's not the destination, it's the journey (aisaidluv.wordpress.com)
reviews.author: Ai
reviews.summary: Blogger's staycation on the 20th floor: spacious, comfortable room, fast Wi-Fi, pool and fitness centre on the 6th floor, and a varied Anigre breakfast (fresh juice, donuts). Loved the one-stop mall integration for shopping and dining.

reviews.title: My Valentine's Dinner at Anigre Sheraton Grand Jakarta Gandaria City
reviews.author: Olyn
reviews.summary: All-you-can-eat buffet at Anigre with lamb, roasted duck, satay, seafood, sushi, pasta and dimsum across Western, Indonesian, Japanese and Chinese stations. Rated really good; crowded on Valentine's at ~IDR 388k but worth it.

reviews.title: Anigre – Sheraton Grand Jakarta Gandaria City Hotel
reviews.author: Cindy
reviews.summary: Food-blogger buffet review of Anigre on the UG floor: fresh sashimi, tender roasted duck, prawns and chili crab, plus customizable pasta and nasi goreng. Praised the fresh ingredients, spacious setting and attentive, efficient service.
